commentary_title: VLGC rates under pressure on narrowing arbitrage
commentary_summary: VLGC transits through Panama increase as more slots become available. | US loadings impacted due to hurricane and Houston shipping channel closure. Consequently, laden tonnage falls in the Atlantic and Pacific. | VLGC spot rates on the AG-Japan route declined 9% WoW in the week ending 2nd August while it remained stable on the US-Japan and US-Europe routes. | Restart of PDH units after scheduled maintenance could increase operating rates; uncertainity revloves around petchem margins
